summary: Practise eligibility checks, benefit calculations and claims controls in a five-day course. Explore the outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: Unemployment insurance administration helps claims officers, scheme analysts and programme leads assess eligibility and calculate benefits from contribution histories. The course covers qualifying-period checks, benefit calculations, claim-decision records, payment and appeal controls, and referrals to employment services. Exercises use case scenarios to create draft operational artefacts for case review and performance reporting; cash-flow projections and digital administration receive practical orientation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who administer, design or oversee unemployment benefit rules and their connection to employment services.
modules: ILO Social Security Inquiry and Coverage
Digital Claims Records and Data Quality
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with social protection, social insurance, unemployment benefit administration or employment services. No coding or programming is required. You should be able to interpret basic contribution and claims records.
